Cristiano Ronaldo has said goodbye to the Portuguese national team. The boy from Madeira who dreamed of representing his country leaves behind a legacy that will live forever. From tears of heartbreak to tears of triumph, he gave his heart and soul to the badge on his chest. He carried the hopes of an entire nation, inspired millions around the world, and turned his childhood dream into one of football's greatest stories. No more seeing him walk out in Portugal's colors. No more hearing the national anthem with Cristiano standing among his teammates. An entire generation grew up watching him, and now we have to learn to watch without him. Football will never feel quite the same. Thank you for the memories, the sacrifices, and the moments we'll cherish forever. Obrigado, Cristiano. ❤️ #ronaldo #cristianoronaldo #viral
